fdroid:com.materializr.app.name: Materializr
fdroid:com.materializr.app.summary: Maker 3D CAD - the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD
fdroid:com.materializr.app.description:
Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers - the middle ground between dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD. Enough genuine solid modeling to make real parts, without a steep learning curve, a subscription, or an account.
Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep), fillet and chamfer, run boolean operations, cut threads, and edit any step of the history later - even after closing and reopening the project.
Sketches export to SVG at 1:1 millimeters for laser cutters and 2.5D CNC. It also imports STEP and IGES, and exports STEP, STL, IGES and glTF.
The geometry kernel is OpenCASCADE - real B-rep solids, not meshes. The interface is touch-capable on Android, designed for tablets and larger screens (on a small phone the panels and toolbars are cramped). File open/save use the system document picker (Storage Access Framework); no broad storage permission is requested.
Young software built quickly, so expect rough edges. Operations validate their results and refuse rather than silently produce garbage, so a failed action leaves your model untouched - but save often, and please report bugs.

fdroid:grmpl.mk.stepandheightcounter.name: Step and Height Counter
fdroid:grmpl.mk.stepandheightcounter.description:
This app counts footsteps and elevation gain if step sensor and barometric sensor is available. 
All data is kept locally only, there is no connection to any server. For statistics you can save your data locally on SD-Card.
Please note: Pressure sensor is mandatory. Steps will not be counted during walking, if there is a step sensor but no pressure sensor. 
Elevation gain should only be counted if footsteps are detected, so only stairs and hill climbing will count, but not elevators or lifts. Don’t expect high accuracy - due to the concept of the sensors the accuracy is limited. And: avoid walking in trains or subways with active measurement, as the pressure (and therefore height) can change significantly during driving. 
You can save regular and daily statistics automatically on SD-Card and save current values with the floating action button. Starting with Android 10 files are not saved to root-folder of SD-card anymore, but in app-directory. There isn’t much on graphical display of statistic data besides two progress bars. Just use any program which can read csv-values. 
 Permissions: 
* Access to physical activity: Access to step sensor needs permission to access physical activity since Android 10+. The app will not work without this permission on devices with Android 10 and higher.
* Keep device awake: Device will not be kept awake all time. It will be woken up regulary and kept awake if necessary for short time to ensure proper counting of steps and elevation gain.
* Write to external storage: App will work without this permission, but you cannot save statistical values or markers.

fdroid:org.emunix.unipatcher.description:
UniPatcher allows you to apply patches to game ROMs.
What is a patch?
A file with the modified data of the game. For example, a game translated from Japanese to English. You download the patch containing the translation. It must be applied to the Japanese version to make an English version of it.
This program will not help you hack native Android games, it was created for the old console games (SNES, PS1, GBA, N64, SMD\Genesis etc.)
Features:
* Supported formats of patches: IPS, IPS32, UPS, BPS, APS (GBA), APS (N64), PPF, DPS, EBP, XDelta
* Create XDelta patches
* Fix the checksum in SMD\Genesis ROMs
* Remove the SMC header from SNES ROMs
How to use?
You have to select a ROM file, a patch and choose which file to save, then click on the button in the bottom. Files are selected through the standard Files application (or through one of the file managers you have installed). The application will show a message when the file is patched. Do not close the application until the file is patched.
Very important:
If the game and patch is compressed (ZIP, RAR, 7z or other), they first need to be unzipped.

• Customizable keyword filters and app whitelist
• Multiple calendar selection support
• Fully offline, no internet permission required
• Privacy-respecting, data never leaves your device

• WeChat/QQ group notifications: "明天下午3点开会" (meeting tomorrow 3pm)
• Work notifications: "周五晚上8点项目汇报" (project report Friday 8pm)

• Foreground service: Keep service running in background
• Exact alarm: Used for crash recovery mechanism
• Query packages: Used for app picker to display installed apps
This app contains no ads, tracking, or data collection.
Target audience: Chinese-speaking users who use Chinese messaging and social apps.

This is the part that matters.
This is the part that is hard to get right.
This is the part that makes the difference between actual security and insecurity.
Claiming “military-grade” or “industry standard” encryption is meaningless.
Even claiming “256-bit AES encryption”, in itself is not very meaningful.
Example:
Claiming “military-grade” encryption and subsequently simply hashing a master passcode - e.g. using SHA, MD5 - is NOT good. 
What ís good is to use a proper key derivation algorithm such as PBKDF2, scrypt or bcrypt.
Another example: 
AES is better than older algorithms such as Blowfish, Twofish or 3DES. 
But even for AES: an app that does not combine encryption with authentication... is doing it wrong. Currently there is some consensus that the best construct is to first encrypt a message and then calculate a message-authentication code, instead of the other way around.
These things matter.
◆ ◆ ◆
The Vault uses PBKDF2 key derivation with an HMAC-SHA512 PRF, and HMAC-SHA256 Encrypt-then-MAC authenticated 256-bit AES encryption, using CommonCrypto functionality only. All cipher and MAC worker keys, as well as all salts and IVs, are purely random data. Keys and IVs are never reused. Each singular piece of data is encrypted with a unique random encryption key, and authenticated with a unique random HMAC key.
Your Master Passcode is never stored; and neither are the derived cipher keys.

apple-macos:1521553621.description:
Scan paper to your iPhone or iPad with the scanner in your printer. No printer app. No account.
Put your pages in the printer and tap Scan. You get flat, sharp pages from a real scanner, as a PDF you can save or send. The app finds scanners on your Wi-Fi by itself.
Scanning is free, so you can check that it works with your printer first. Saving and sharing need a one-time purchase. No subscription.
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO DO?
Need to send a letter, a contract or a form?
Scan it, then tap Send to email it as a PDF. Or tap Save to keep it in Files. All the pages go into one PDF.
Have a stack printed on both sides?
Put it in the feeder, the tray on top of your printer, and tap Scan. You get the pages in order, and blank back sides are left out. If your feeder scans one side only, the app asks you for the back sides and puts the pages in order.
Want your old family photos on your iPhone or iPad?
Tap Document and choose Photos. Lay several photos face down and straight on the glass, a finger's width apart, and put a sheet of dark paper over them. It helps the app cut each photo out. Tap Scan. When the app can see where each photo ends, each one becomes its own picture. Tap Save to add them to Photos.
Need a copy of a receipt or an ID card?
Put it on the glass and tap Scan. The app crops it to its edges when it can see them.
Need to find a word in a scan, or copy text from it?
Open your saved PDF. Printed text inside is searchable, and you can copy it.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi as your printer.
2. Open the app and tap Continue. Your iPhone or iPad asks if the app may find devices on your Wi-Fi. Allow it. That is how the app reaches your scanner.
3. Put your pages in the feeder or on the glass, and tap Scan. Keep the app open until the scan is done.
4. Tap Save to keep the PDF in Files, or Send to share it by Mail, Messages, AirDrop and more. Saving and sharing need the one-time purchase.
Your scanner is remembered. Next time, just tap Scan. To use another scanner, tap its name near the Scan button.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Color, paper size and quality are chosen for you. Tap Options to change them.
- No feeder? Scan one page at a time on the glass. Tap Scan More for the next page.
- Pages of text scanned upside down or sideways are turned the right way up.
- Rotate, reorder or delete pages, and rename your scan, before you save.
- PDFs are kept small, so most scans are easy to email.
- Need pictures instead of a PDF? Tap the title at the top, then Save as Images.
- Paper jam? The app tells you which sheet to put back and keeps the pages already scanned.
- Closed the app before saving or sending? Your pages are still there when you come back.
- The app keeps no list of old scans. Once saved, you find them in Files or Photos.
WILL IT WORK WITH MY PRINTER?
You need a printer with a scanner, or a scanner, that can scan over Wi-Fi without its maker's app. Many Wi-Fi printers can. Some need network scanning turned on in their own settings.
The quickest way to know is to scan a page. It is free.
The app does not scan with the camera. A scanner connected only by a USB cable can't be used with iPhone or iPad.
Can't find your scanner? Tap Get Help in the app. It shows what to check, and you can add your scanner by its address.
ONE-TIME PURCHASE
One purchase unlocks saving and sharing on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account. No subscription.
Bought it on your Mac? You won't pay again. If saving is still locked, tap Restore Purchase in the app's Settings.
YOUR PRIVACY
Your scans stay on your iPhone or iPad until you save or send them. No account, no ads, no analytics.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-guava/gap-pkg-gu.name: gap-pkg-guava
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-guava/gap-pkg-gu.description: GUAVA is a package that implements coding theory algorithms in GAP. Codes can be created and manipulated and information about codes can be calculated. GUAVA consists of various files written in the GAP language, and an external program from J. S. Leon for dealing with automorphism groups of codes and isomorphism testing functions. Several algorithms that need the speed are integrated in the GAP kernel. The functions within GUAVA can be divided into four categories: - Construction of codes. GUAVA can construct non-linear, linear and cyclic codes over an arbitrary finite field. Examples are HadamardCode, ReedMullerCode, BestKnownLinearCode, QRCode and GoppaCode. - Manipulation of codes. These functions allow the user to transform one code into another or to construct a new code from two codes. Examples are PuncturedCode, DualCode, DirectProductCode and UUVCode. - Computation of information about codes. This information is stored in the code record. Examples are MinimumDistance, OuterDistribution, IsSelfDualCode and AutomorphismGroup. - Generation of bounds on linear codes. The table by Brouwer and Verhoeff (as it existed in the mid-1990s) is incorporated into GUAVA. For example, BoundsMinimumDistance.

While mpv strives for minimalism and provides no real GUI, it has a small controller on top of the video for basic control. Mpv can leverage most hardware decoding APIs on all platforms. firefox-addons:3049387.name: Udemy Translator
firefox-addons:3049387.summary: A Firefox extension that translates subtitles of Udemy content and reads them out with a synthetic voice.
firefox-addons:3049387.description:
Udemy Translator
Udemy Translator is a browser extension that translates subtitles on Udemy video lectures in real time and reads them aloud using native Operating System Text-to-Speech (TTS) voices.
Key Features
Real-Time Subtitle Translation: Automatically translates captions into your preferred target language as you watch Udemy courses.
Native OS Text-to-Speech (TTS): Reads translated subtitles out loud using high-quality system TTS voices installed on your device.
Multiple Translation Providers: Supports MyMemory Translation API as default and Google Translate with automatic failover between services.
Adaptive Speed Synchronization: Dynamically adjusts speech speed (up to 3.0x) to ensure audio finishes reading before the next subtitle cue appears.
Instant Audio Control: Audio immediately stops when you pause or seek through a video.
Customizable Subtitle Overlay: Moveable caption box over the video player with adjustable font size and background transparency.
Full Volume Control: Comes with full volume output (100% by default) and configurable speech rate.
Multilingual Support: Supports over 30 languages including Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more.
System Requirements
To enable text-to-speech reading in your target language, ensure that the corresponding TTS voice package is installed on your operating system:
Windows:
Open Settings > Time & Language > Speech.
Click Add voices and select your desired target language (e.g., Arabic, Spanish, French).
macOS:
Open System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content.
Click System Voice and download the voice pack for your target language.
Linux / Android:
Install standard speech synthesis engine packages (such as speech-dispatcher or Google Speech Services).
User Guide & How to Use
1. Installation
Install the extension in your browser (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Mozilla Firefox).
Click on the extension icon in your browser toolbar to open the settings panel.
2. Basic Configuration
Translation: Turn ON to enable real-time subtitle translation.
Translate To: Select your desired target language.
Translation Provider: Choose between MyMemory (Free) or Google Translate.
Speak: Turn ON to enable voice reading of subtitles.
Voice Selection: Choose your preferred installed system voice engine.
Volume & Speed: Adjust volume level and base speech rate.
Font Size & Opacity: Customize subtitle text appearance on the screen.
3. Usage on Udemy
Open any course video on Udemy.
Turn ON captions/subtitles in the Udemy video player.
The extension will automatically translate the captions and read them aloud in sync with the video.
Pausing the video automatically stops the audio immediately.

firefox-addons:936501.name: Download with FlashGet
firefox-addons:936501.summary: when activated, interrupts the built-in download manager to direct links to FlashGet
firefox-addons:936501.description:
This extension offers integration with FlashGet download manager. By default the toolbar icon is disabled. In this mode, downloads are handled by the internal download manager. Once the extension is enabled from the toolbar button (when the icon is colorful), then an observer is installed. This observer monitors new downloads and sends requests to FlashGet and cancels the built-in downloads. It is also possible to use right-click over links option to send links to FlashGet without installing the download observer.
Notes:
1. For the extension to work you need to have FlashGet (version 1.7 or 1.9) installed; FlashGet 1.9.6.1073 https://filehippo.com/download_flashget/3229/ 
FlashGet 1.73 https://filehippo.com/download_flashget/1541/ 
2. FlashGet versions 3.x do not support command-line options and hence are not supported.
3. For the extension to be able to start FlashGet and communicate with it, a small native client is required. This native client can be found at https://github.com/belaviyo/native-client/releases . You will get the instruction on how to install this native client when extension tries to communicate for the first time.
For more info please visit:
 http://add0n.com/download-with.html?from=flashget

firefox-addons:2932951.name: TanStack Query DevTools
firefox-addons:2932951.summary: Real-time TanStack Query devtools in your browser. Inspect queries, mutations, and cache — with zero bundle impact.
firefox-addons:2932951.description:
Debug TanStack Query without shipping devtools to production. 
See every query and mutation the moment it changes — cache state, status
transitions, full data payloads — from your browser toolbar or right inside
DevTools. No package to install, no bundle to grow, nothing to strip before
release.
 WHAT YOU GET 
 Live inspection — queries and mutations update in real time as your app runs
 Deep dive — status, data, and metadata for any single query or mutation
 Interactive data tree — expand, collapse, and explore deeply nested payloads
 Inline editing — change cached data on the spot and watch your UI react
 One-click cache actions — invalidate, refetch, reset, or remove queries; clear the mutation cache
 Status at a glance — fresh, stale, fetching, paused, inactive, error
 Search & sort — find any query by key; sort by key, status, or last updated
 Two ways to work — toolbar popup for a quick peek, DevTools panel for a real session
 Stays connected — survives page navigation within the tab
 SETUP IS ONE LINE 
 window.__TANSTACK_QUERY_CLIENT__ = queryClient;
Reload your app. The toolbar icon lights up the moment a QueryClient is
detected. Click it for the popup, or open DevTools → TanStack Query for the
full panel.
 WHY NOT THE BUILT-IN DEVTOOLS? 
 Zero bundle impact — nothing ships to production, ever
 Framework-agnostic — React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Angular: if it runs TanStack Query, it works
 Sits alongside your other DevTools panels instead of floating over your app
 No conditional imports, no tree-shaking tricks, no cleanup before release
Free and open source (MIT):
 github.com/DeeCode-inc/tanstack-query-chrome-devtools

Short home workouts for every fitness level, from the makers of Streaks.
Pick a workout, press start and follow along on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch or Apple TV.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
The app comes with 30 exercises that need no equipment, just a few minutes and a floor. You choose which exercises you want to do, so it works for all ages and abilities.
WORKOUT PACKS
Workout Packs add more workouts and 100 more exercises when you want them. They're optional one-time in-app purchases, and you can use them on all your devices. Three are free.
Some packs add exercises you can use in your own workouts and random workouts, and each comes with workouts of its own. There are packs for calisthenics, kettlebell, yoga, stretching and mobility, plyometrics, core, and HIIT and cardio.
Other packs are ready-made workouts. There are packs for core strength, fat-burning HIIT, lower body, postnatal workouts, and quiet workouts with no jumping. Ring Chaser has workouts with no set length that keep going until your Move and Exercise goals for the day are met. Recharge has six sessions to boost your energy.
The free packs are Fresh Start (beginner workouts), Shake It Out (warm-up moves) and All-Rounder (one exercise from six of the paid packs). Next Level, with harder versions of the basics, comes with the app.
FEATURES
* 4 workout lengths (about 6, 12, 18 or 30 minutes), or set your own
* Create custom exercises and custom workouts
* Set the time for each exercise and the rest between exercises and sets, or build interval workouts
* Up to 1,000 reps per set, or Until Done sets that keep going until you tap
* Pick any color for a custom workout
* Voice guidance through your workout, with three coaches to choose from
* Live heart rate zones during workouts with Apple Watch
* Trophies for streaks, milestones, exercises and packs
* My Stats, with best sets, records, trends and a chart for each exercise
* A home screen with your week, your streak and your best sets
* Plays workout music (requires Apple Music subscription)
* Saves workouts to the Health app
* View your workout history
* Siri and Shortcuts support
* Widgets for your Home Screen
* Syncs your data across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV
If you have any questions or comments, please contact support@streaksworkout.app
ABOUT HEALTH DATA:
On supported devices, Streaks Workout accesses the Health app to read and write workout data with your permission. All data is accessed in full accordance with the iOS app review rules set by Apple. Please read our privacy policy at https://streaksworkout.app/privacy for more information on our use of data.
